name: Bombay Coated and Special Steels
summary: Bombay Coated and Special Steels processes coated and flat steel (slitting, cut-to-length, shearing, embossing) for appliance, engineering, automotive and electrical makers from four plants in Maharashtra, Rajasthan and Andhra Pradesh, and is an authorised service partner of JSW Steel Coated Products. Revenue grew from ₹755 cr in FY24 to ₹1,267 cr in FY26, but profit rose only 6.5% in FY26 to ₹30.5 cr and the net margin is thin at 2.4%. The whole ₹183 cr issue is fresh money, but about 68% of it goes to repaying debt; debt to equity was 2.78 before the issue. At the upper band the post-issue P/E is about 16.9x, below the median of the listed peers named in the RHP.

checks.name: Revenue growth
checks.finding: Revenue rose from ₹755.3 cr (FY24) to ₹1,266.8 cr (FY26), a CAGR of about 29.5%.

checks.name: Revenue rose every year
checks.finding: Revenue grew every year: ₹755 cr, ₹1,056 cr, ₹1,267 cr (FY24–FY26).

checks.name: Debt to equity
checks.finding: Debt to equity was 2.78 in FY26 (borrowings ₹338.5 cr vs net worth ₹121.6 cr).

checks.name: Debt growing slower than revenue
checks.finding: Borrowings rose 45% (₹234 cr to ₹338 cr) while total income rose 66% over FY24–FY26.

checks.name: Net worth rising
checks.finding: Net worth rose every year: ₹54.4 cr, ₹83.1 cr, ₹121.6 cr (FY24–FY26).

checks.name: Positive operating cash flow
checks.finding: Operating cash flow was ₹10.2 cr in FY26, only about a third of the ₹30.5 cr profit.

checks.name: Profit growth
checks.finding: Profit after tax grew 6.5% in FY26, to ₹30.5 cr, while revenue grew about 20%.

checks.name: Profit margin trend
checks.finding: Net margin slipped from 2.80% (FY24) to 2.72% (FY25) and 2.40% (FY26).

checks.name: Return on equity
checks.finding: Return on net worth was 25.1% in FY26, helped by the small equity base.

checks.name: Return on capital employed
checks.finding: ROCE was 16.4% in FY26, down from 18.8% in FY25.
